name: contract-json-format
goal: Keep generated entity contracts both registry-canonical and Prettier-clean

evidence: Indexing rewrites 12 migrated manifests because stableJson differs from Prettier for arrays containing empty containers and nested primitive arrays. Formatting those manifests makes registry checks stale. Existing style examples covered primitive arrays and nonempty object arrays but missed those admitted JSON shapes.

Strengthen the existing stableJson Prettier-style Example with empty-container and nested-array matrices, width boundaries and direct getter/species/iterator observation. Preserve all 12 Example names, IDs, outcomes and existing assertion boundaries; no new test case.
